## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle anonymous variant *prātimokṣa* commentary fragment, preserved in Dunhuang. The variant relationship with [KR6k0134](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0134) reflects the multiplicity of Vinaya commentary streams in Tang-period Dunhuang.

**Abstract**

Companion to [KR6k0134](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0134); both are Dunhuang fragments of *Sìfēn prātimokṣa* commentaries in slightly variant manuscript transmissions. Together they testify to the diversity of Vinaya scholarship in northwestern Tang Buddhist communities.
